PRESIDENTIAL TOWN HALL WITH KAMALA HARRIS

spoken_summary: Anderson Cooper asks Kamala Harris directly, "Do you think Donald Trump is a fascist?" Harris replies unequivocally, "Yes I do, yes I do." She elaborates that she believes the people who know him best on the subject should be trusted.
